task: Train a fixed Kuhn game and independently enumerate best responses to its average policy.
limitations: Three-card ante-one/bet-one Kuhn only; no general-game or real-money performance claim.
Claim gates report assertions, not Lean verification. The optional local manifest-metadata test may skip; no kernel replay is claimed.
Measured exploitability is half the sum of the two finite-game best-response gains; algebraic bound APIs are separate.
Private source/package; no visibility flip is performed.
